$Global:MasterSecretsPath = "$env:USERPROFILE\.ai-secrets\master.env"

function Load-AISecrets {
    param(
        [switch]$Silent,
        [string[]]$OnlyServices = @()  # e.g., @("openrouter", "github") to load subset
    )
    
    if (-not (Test-Path $Global:MasterSecretsPath)) {
        if (-not $Silent) { Write-Warning "No master.env found at $Global:MasterSecretsPath" }
        return $false
    }
    
    $Loaded = 0
    Get-Content $Global:MasterSecretsPath | ForEach-Object {
        # Skip comments and blank lines
        if ($_ -match '^\s*#' -or $_ -match '^\s*$') { return }
        
        if ($_ -match '^\s*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=\s*(.*)\s*$') {
            $Key = $matches[1]
            $Value = $matches[2]
            
            # Skip empty values (not yet filled in)
            if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Value)) { return }
            
            [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($Key, $Value, "Process")
            $Loaded++
        }
    }
    
    if (-not $Silent) {
        Write-Host "🔑 Loaded $Loaded secrets from master vault" -ForegroundColor Green
    }
    
    return $true
}

function Show-AIServices {
    $Services = @{}
    Get-ChildItem env: | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '_API_KEY$|_TOKEN$|_SECRET$|_PASSWORD$|_URL$' } | ForEach-Object {
        $Svc = $_.Name -replace '_.*', ''
        if (-not $Services[$Svc]) { $Services[$Svc] = @() }
        $Services[$Svc] += $_.Name
    }
    
    $Services.GetEnumerator() | Sort-Object Name | ForEach-Object {
        Write-Host "`n[$($_.Key)]" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        $_.Value | ForEach-Object { 
            $Val = (Get-Item "env:$_").Value
            $Masked = if ($Val.Length -gt 8) { $Val.Substring(0,4) + '****' + $Val.Substring($Val.Length-4) } else { '****' }
            Write-Host "  $_ = $Masked" 
        }
    }
}

    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Name)

# Target: C:\Users\Dekan AI Brother

function Write-Log($msg) {
    $ts = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"

}

Write-Log "=== SMART node_modules AUDIT START ==="
Write-Log "Target: $home"

Write-Log ""

# --- PHASE 1: FIND ALL node_modules ---

# --- PHASE 2: ANALYZE EACH node_modules ---
Write-Log "`n=== PHASE 2: PROJECT ANALYSIS PER node_modules ==="

$results = @()
$totalFiles = 0
$totalSize = 0

foreach ($nm in $allNodeModules) {
    $nmPath = $nm.FullName
    $nmParent = $nm.Parent.FullName
    $nmParentName = $nm.Parent.Name

    # Count files and size in this node_modules
    $files = Get-ChildItem -Path $nmPath -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $fileCount = $files.Count
    $size = ($files | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum
    $sizeMB = [math]::Round($size / 1MB, 2)
    $totalFiles += $fileCount
    $totalSize += $size

    # Check if parent is a real project
    $hasPackageJson = Test-Path (Join-Path $nmParent "package.json")
    $hasGit = Test-Path (Join-Path $nmParent ".git")
    $hasSrc = Test-Path (Join-Path $nmParent "src")
    $hasApp = Test-Path (Join-Path $nmParent "app")

    # Check recency of parent folder (any file modified in last 30 days?)
    $recentFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $nmParent -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {
        $_.LastWriteTime -gt (Get-Date).AddDays(-30)
    }
    $isRecent = $recentFiles.Count -gt 0
    $recentCount = $recentFiles.Count

    # Check if parent is a known active project by name
    $activeKeywords = @("casa", "companion", "enpro", "epo", "crowdsource", "voice", "pipecat", "gce", "dekan", "active")
    $isLikelyActive = $false
    foreach ($kw in $activeKeywords) {
        if ($nmParentName.ToLower() -like "*$kw*") {
            $isLikelyActive = $true
            break
        }
    }

    # Determine recommendation
    $recommendation = "UNKNOWN"
    $reason = ""

    if ($hasPackageJson -and ($hasGit -or $hasSrc -or $hasApp) -and ($isRecent -or $isLikelyActive)) {
        $recommendation = "KEEP"
        $reason = "Active project: package.json + source + recent activity"
    }
    elseif ($hasPackageJson -and ($hasGit -or $hasSrc -or $hasApp) -and !$isRecent) {
        $recommendation = "REVIEW"
        $reason = "Stale project: has source but no recent activity"
    }
    elseif ($hasPackageJson -and !$hasGit -and !$hasSrc -and !$hasApp) {
        $recommendation = "DELETE"
        $reason = "No source code — likely downloaded dependency dump"
    }
    elseif (!$hasPackageJson) {
        $recommendation = "DELETE"
        $reason = "No package.json — orphaned node_modules"
    }
    elseif ($nmParentName -like "*Kimi_Agent*" -or $nmParentName -like "*download*" -or $nmParentName -like "*New folder*") {
        $recommendation = "DELETE"
        $reason = "Known download/abandoned folder"
    }
    else {
        $recommendation = "REVIEW"
        $reason = "Ambiguous — inspect manually"
    }

    $result = [PSCustomObject]@{
        node_modules_Path = $nmPath
        Parent_Name = $nmParentName
        Parent_Path = $nmParent
        Files = $fileCount
        Size_MB = $sizeMB
        Has_package_json = $hasPackageJson
        Has_git = $hasGit
        Has_src = $hasSrc
        Has_app = $hasApp
        Recent_Files_30d = $recentCount
        Is_Recent = $isRecent
        Is_Likely_Active = $isLikelyActive
        Recommendation = $recommendation
        Reason = $reason
    }

    $results += $result

    Write-Log "[$recommendation] $nmParentName | $fileCount files | $sizeMB MB | $reason"
}

# --- PHASE 3: SUMMARY BY RECOMMENDATION ---
Write-Log "`n=== PHASE 3: SUMMARY BY RECOMMENDATION ==="

$grouped = $results | Group-Object Recommendation
foreach ($g in $grouped) {

    $groupFiles = ($g.Group | Measure-Object -Property Files -Sum).Sum
    Write-Log "$($g.Name): $($g.Count) locations | $groupFiles files | $([math]::Round($groupSize, 2)) MB"
}

    Write-Log "  Recent files (30d): $($k.Recent_Files_30d)"
    Write-Log ""
}

# --- PHASE 6: STALE PROJECTS NEEDING REVIEW ---
Write-Log "=== PHASE 6: STALE / REVIEW PROJECTS ==="

$reviewProjects = $results | Where-Object { $_.Recommendation -eq "REVIEW" } | Sort-Object Size_MB -Descending

    Write-Log "  Reason: $($r.Reason)"

}

$credentialFiles = @()

foreach ($path in $searchPaths) {
    if (Test-Path $path) {
        foreach ($pattern in $patterns) {
            $found = Get-ChildItem -Path $path -Recurse -Filter $pattern -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue -Force
            $credentialFiles += $found
        }
    }
}

# Deduplicate and sort
$credentialFiles = $credentialFiles | Select-Object -Property FullName, LastWriteTime, Length -Unique | Sort-Object FullName

# --- STEP 2: EXTRACT & PARSE ---
$allSecrets = @()
foreach ($file in $credentialFiles) {
    $content = Get-Content -Path $file.FullName -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $lines = $content -split "`n"
    
    foreach ($line in $lines) {
        # Match KEY=VALUE patterns (skip comments and empty lines)
        if ($line -match '^\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*=\s*(.+)\s*$') {
            $key = $matches[1].Trim()
            $value = $matches[2].Trim().Trim('"').Trim("'")
            
            # Flag known credential patterns
            $isCredential = $key -match '(?i)(key|token|secret|password|api|azure|deepgram|openai|groq|anthropic|aws|gcp|firebase|supabase|mongo|postgres|db_|auth|jwt|webhook)'
            
            $allSecrets += [PSCustomObject]@{
                SourceFile = $file.FullName
                Key = $key
                Value = $value
                IsCredential = $isCredential
                IsPlaceholder = $value -match '(?i)(your_|placeholder|example|dummy|test|xxx|todo|change)'
                Line = $line.Trim()
            }
        }
    }
}

# --- STEP 3: GROUP BY KEY & DETECT CONFLICTS ---
$grouped = $allSecrets | Group-Object Key
$conflicts = $grouped | Where-Object { $_.Count -gt 1 -and ($_.Group | Select-Object Value -Unique).Count -gt 1 }

# Credential Audit Log — $(Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm")
## Files Scanned: $($credentialFiles.Count)

$($credentialFiles | ForEach-Object { "- $($_.FullName)" } | Out-String)

### All Variables:
$($allSecrets | ForEach-Object { "| $($_.Key) | $($_.SourceFile) | $(if($_.IsCredential){'🔴'}else{'🟢'}) | $(if($_.IsPlaceholder){'⚠️ PLACEHOLDER'}else{'ACTIVE'}) |" } | Out-String)

### CONFLICTS (Same key, different values):
$($conflicts | ForEach-Object {

    $vals = $_.Group | Select-Object Value, SourceFile -Unique
    "**$key** found in:`n$($vals | ForEach-Object { "- $($_.SourceFile): $($_.Value.Substring(0,[Math]::Min(20,$_.Value.Length)))..." } | Out-String)"
} | Out-String)

### REVIEW CHECKLIST:
- [ ] Verify each key is still needed
- [ ] Resolve conflicts (pick correct value)
- [ ] Mark placeholders for update
- [ ] Delete old .env files after migration
- [ ] Add .env to .gitignore in all repos
"@

$reviewLog | Out-File -FilePath $reviewLogPath -Encoding utf8

# DATABASE / SUPABASE ===
# OTHER ===

"@

# Build unique keys (prefer non-placeholder values, flag conflicts)

    $best = $_.Group | Sort-Object { $_.IsPlaceholder } | Select-Object -First 1
    $comment = if ($_.Count -gt 1) { " # CONFLICT: $($_.Count) sources" } else { " # From: $(Split-Path $best.SourceFile -Leaf)" }
    "$($best.Key)=$($best.Value)$comment"
}

$masterEnv += ($uniqueKeys | Sort-Object) -join "`n"

# Show everything to user

$credentialFiles | Format-Table FullName, LastWriteTime, Length -AutoSize
